author: reek
body: Proves the opponent-hand belief model. An agent casts a hand-reveal (Duress) and sees three cards; then it watches each one leave the opponent's hand a different way and confirms the model tracks where each went. A card that has not moved is still believed in hand; a cast card is on the battlefield; a discarded card is in the graveyard; an exiled card is in exile. The "still in hand" count reflects only cards the agent has no later sighting of.
